bar.missing: lofi-player isn't installed. Click to set it up.
panel.title: Lofi Player
setup.heading: The lofi command isn't on your PATH.
setup.verify: If lofi-player is already installed, make sure the folder that holds it is on the PATH your session starts with, then check again. Otherwise, install it with the command below, or let the plugin install it for you.
setup.copyTooltip: Copy the install command to the clipboard
setup.terminalHint: Paste it into a terminal. It installs mpv, yt-dlp, socat, and jq if they're missing, then puts lofi in ~/.local/bin.
setup.installHint: Install for me opens a terminal that runs the same command. It may ask for your password to install packages.
setup.waiting: Finish the installer in the terminal. This panel switches to the player once lofi is found.
player.nothing: Nothing played yet. Pick a stream below.
player.resumeHint: Last played. Press Play to resume it.
streams.loading: Fetching live streams from your channels…
streams.none: None of your channels are live right now.
streams.hint: Click a stream to play it. Add channels with lofi add @handle.
